text:
英语词汇 · 专八 · 第 63 单元

apron
音标：英 /'eɪpr(ə)n/  美 /'eprən/
n. 围裙；[航] 停机坪；舞台口
vt. 着围裙于；围绕
短语：parking apron — 停机坪
短语：wharf apron — 码头岸肩；自码头货棚至水边间的空间

apt
音标：英 /æpt/  美 /æpt/
adj. 恰当的；有…倾向的；灵敏的
n. (Apt)人名；(法、波、英)阿普特
例句：‘Love at first sight’ is a very apt description of how he felt when he saw her.
用“一见钟情”来形容他见到她时的感觉再恰当不过。

aptitude
音标：英 /'æptɪtjuːd/  美 /ˈæptɪˌtud, -ˌtjud/
n. 天资；自然倾向；适宜
短语：aptitude test — 能力倾向测验；才能测验；能力测试
短语：have an aptitude for — 有…的才能；有…的天性，有…的自然倾向
短语：academic aptitude — 学术能力倾向；学术才能
例句：He drifted into publishing and discovered an aptitude for working with accounts.
他偶入出版界，发现自己具有管账的天资。

aquarium
音标：英 /ə'kweərɪəm/  美 /ə'kwɛrɪəm/
n. 水族馆；养鱼池；玻璃缸
短语：vancouver aquarium — 温哥华水族馆（北美洲三大水族馆之一）
例句：In Amsterdam the girls all stand in the windows shimmering as tantalising as tropical fish beyond the gleam of aquarium glass.
在阿姆斯特丹，姑娘们都站在窗后，光芒四射柔情撩人宛如水族馆玻璃背后脉脉含情的热带鱼。

aquatic
音标：英 /ə'kwætɪk; -'kwɒt-/  美 /ə'kwætɪk/
adj. 水生的；水栖的；在水中或水面进行的
n. 水上运动；水生植物或动物

短语：aquatic environment — 水生环境
短语：aquatic plant — 水生植物
短语：aquatic animal — 水生动物；水产动物
短语：aquatic resources — 水产资源；水生资源

短语：aquatic organism — 水生生物
短语：aquatic sports — 水上运动
短语：aquatic ecology — 水域生态学；水生生物生态学
短语：aquatic biology — 水生生物学
例句：an aquatic plant
水生植物

音标：英 /ə'reibiə/  美 /ə'reibiə/
n. 阿拉伯半岛（亚洲西南部，等于Arabian Peninsula）
短语：saudi arabia — n. 沙特阿拉伯

挪威和沙特阿拉伯的财政大员就没有理由担心他们的借贷成本，因为他们是净债权人。

短语：arabian gulf — 阿拉伯湾

例句：The European Court of Justice will be the final arbiter (=  make the final decision  ) in the dispute.
欧洲法庭将对这宗争端作出最终裁决。

arbitrary
音标：英 /'ɑːbɪt(rə)rɪ/  美 /ˈɑːrbətreri/

v. 仲裁；公断
例句：He arbitrates between investors and members of the association.
他在投资者与该协会成员之间做仲裁。

arc
音标：英 /ɑːk/  美 /ɑrk/
n. 弧（度）；弧光（全称electric arc）；弧形物；天穹
adj. 圆弧的；反三角函数的

短语：arc welding — 电弧焊，弧焊；电弧焊接
短语：arc furnace — 电弧炉，直接电弧炉

短语：plasma arc — 等离子弧，等离子体电弧；电浆弧
短语：electric arc furnace — [化]电弧炉
短语：circular arc — 圆弧
短语：submerged arc welding — 埋弧焊
短语：argon arc — 氩弧焊
短语：arc voltage — 弧电压
短语：argon arc welding — 氩弧焊
短语：arc length — 弧长
短语：welding arc — 焊弧
短语：arc discharge — 弧放电
短语：island arc — [地]弧形列岛
短语：plasma arc welding — 等离子弧焊；等离子电弧焊接
短语：joan of arc — 圣女贞德（法国民族女英雄）
短语：metal arc welding — 金属电弧焊；金属弧焊接
短语：manual arc welding — 手工电弧焊
短语：arc welder — 电焊机；焊工
例句：the arc of a rainbow

arcade
音标：英 /ɑː'keɪd/  美 /ɑr'ked/
n. 拱廊；（内设投角子电子游戏机等的）游乐场；有拱廊的街道
vt. 使有拱廊
短语：shopping arcade — 购物商场；商店街，商场部
短语：arcade game — 电脑游戏（游乐场的）
例句：arcade games
游戏厅的电子游戏

arch
音标：英 /ɑːtʃ/  美 /ɑrtʃ/
n. 弓形，拱形；拱门
adj. 主要的
v. 使…弯成弓形；用拱连接
短语：arch bridge — 拱形桥
短语：arch dam — 拱坝，拱形坝
短语：aortic arch — 主动脉弓；织脉弓
短语：arch rib — 拱肋
短语：stone arch — 石拱
短语：vertebral arch — 椎弓；椎体
短语：arch support — 足弓垫；护弓具；拱形支架
短语：zygomatic arch — 颧弓
短语：triumphal arch — n. 凯旋门
短语：arch crown — 拱顶
短语：arch truss — 拱形桁架
短语：marble arch — 大理石拱门（有名的伦敦标志）
短语：round arch — 半圆拱
短语：pointed arch — 尖拱；尖券
短语：memorial arch — 牌坊
短语：circular arch — 圆拱
短语：arch over — 拱悬于之上；把拱盖起来
短语：pedicle of vertebral arch — 椎弓根
短语：arch axis — 拱形轴
短语：gothic arch — 哥特式尖拱
例句：When she passed under the arch leading out of the park, Mira whooped with delight.
从通向公园外的拱门下走过时，米拉高兴地喊叫起来。

archaeologist
音标：英 /,ɑːkɪ'ɒlədʒɪst/  美 /,ɑrkɪ'ɑlədʒɪst/
n. 考古学家
例句：In fact, she was an archaeologist.
其实她是一个考古学家。
例句：But I do not believe, as a field archaeologist, that we can use the scientific method to prove or disprove [them].
但作为一个在现场工作的考古学家，我不相信我们能用科学手段对它们进行证实或证伪”。

archaeology
音标：英 /,ɑːkɪ'ɒlədʒɪ/  美 /,ɑrkɪ'ɑlədʒi/
n. 考古学
例句：He specializes in archaeology.
他专修考古学。
例句：In my recent research, I found that all three come together and, what is more, they help me to show that archaeology has relevance – it is not just old stones and bones.
我在最近的研究中发现，这三点综合发生着作用，除此之外，它们也帮助我发现考古学的重要意义，它不仅仅意味着一堆石头和骨头。
例句："There was no access to clean water, there was no access to basic education especially in the rural areas where the archaeology was," she says.
在那里的考古学特别是农村地区，我们并没有获得干净的水，有没有基本的教育的机会，“她说。

archaic
音标：英 /ɑː'keɪɪk/  美 /ɑr'keɪk/
adj. 古代的；陈旧的；古体的；古色古香的
例句：archaic words
古词

archbishop
音标：英 /ɑːtʃ'bɪʃəp; 'ɑːtʃ-/  美 /,ɑrtʃ'bɪʃəp/
n. 大主教；总教主
例句：When I speak to my archbishop in San Francisco and his role is to try to change my mind on the subject, well then he is exercising his pastoral duty to me as one of his flock.
我在旧金山和我的大主教谈话时，他的任务是努力改变我在那个主题上的看法，那时，他是把我当作他的一只羔羊在实践其牧师的职责。
例句：Only once, and then obliquely, were the uncounted mass of Iraqi dead referred to, when the archbishop prayed for "those whose memory we cherish, and those whose names we will never know".
大主教只有一次、而且是拐弯抹角地提到了不可胜数的死去的伊拉克人，他为“那些受我们怀念的人，以及那些我们永远都不知道名字的人”做了祈祷。

archer
音标：英 /'ɑːtʃə/  美 /'ɑrtʃɚ/
n. 弓箭手
例句：He's an archer, I think.
我觉得他是一个弓箭手。

archetype
音标：英 /'ɑːkɪtaɪp/  美 /'ɑrkə'taɪp/
n. 原型
例句：He came to this country 20 years ago and is the archetype of the successful Asian businessman.
他20年前来到这个国家，是成功的亚裔商人的典型。
typingText:
apron

‘Love at first sight’ is a very apt description of how he felt when he saw her.

He drifted into publishing and discovered an aptitude for working with accounts.

In Amsterdam the girls all stand in the windows shimmering as tantalising as tropical fish beyond the gleam of aquarium glass.

an aquatic plant

The finance ministers of Norway and Saudi Arabia have no cause to worry about their borrowing costs because they are net creditors.

...the Arabian Peninsula.

...the development of modern Arabic literature.

...Arabic music.

The European Court of Justice will be the final arbiter (=  make the final decision  ) in the dispute.

an arbitrary decision

the arbitrary arrests of political opponents

He arbitrates between investors and members of the association.

the arc of a rainbow

arcade games

When she passed under the arch leading out of the park, Mira whooped with delight.

In fact, she was an archaeologist.

But I do not believe, as a field archaeologist, that we can use the scientific method to prove or disprove [them].

He specializes in archaeology.

In my recent research, I found that all three come together and, what is more, they help me to show that archaeology has relevance – it is not just old stones and bones.

"There was no access to clean water, there was no access to basic education especially in the rural areas where the archaeology was," she says.

archaic words

When I speak to my archbishop in San Francisco and his role is to try to change my mind on the subject, well then he is exercising his pastoral duty to me as one of his flock.

Only once, and then obliquely, were the uncounted mass of Iraqi dead referred to, when the archbishop prayed for "those whose memory we cherish, and those whose names we will never know".

He's an archer, I think.

He came to this country 20 years ago and is the archetype of the successful Asian businessman.
